results.name: Dumbbell External Rotation
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand. Keep your opposite hand behind your back for support.
Start with your working arm bent at a 90-degree angle, elbow close to your side, forearm parallel to the floor facing forward with the dumbbell held in a neutral position.
Rotate your forearm outward, keeping your elbow fixed in place, until your palm faces forward.
Slowly return to the starting position, bringing your forearm back to starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
tips: Keep your wrist straight and aligned with your forearm to avoid strain.
Avoid rotating your torso; focus on moving just your forearm.
Perform the exercise in front of a mirror to ensure proper form and alignment.
results.description: Dumbbell External Rotation is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Rear Shoulders.

results.name: Dumbbell Face Down Lying Shoulder Press (45 Degree View)
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with your legs bent at 90 degrees and crossed together. Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your arms bent and elbows pointing outwards at shoulder height.
Begin with the dumbbells at shoulder level, palms facing the floor. Press the dumbbells forward by extending your arms until your arms are fully extended but not locked out.
Slowly bring the dumbbells back to the starting position at shoulder level, maintaining control throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your wrists remain straight and aligned with your forearms.
Keep your chest and abdomen firmly against the bench to avoid arching your back.
Use a weight that allows you to maintain proper form throughout the exercise.
results.description: Dumbbell Face Down Lying Shoulder Press (45 Degree View) is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Dumbbell Face Down Lying Shoulder Press
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with your legs bent at 90 degrees and crossed together. Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your arms bent and elbows pointing outwards at shoulder height.
Begin with the dumbbells at shoulder level, palms facing the floor. Press the dumbbells forward by extending your arms until your arms are fully extended but not locked out.
Slowly bring the dumbbells back to the starting position at shoulder level, maintaining control throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your wrists remain straight and aligned with your forearms.
Keep your chest and abdomen firmly against the bench to avoid arching your back.
Use a weight that allows you to maintain proper form throughout the exercise.
results.description: Dumbbell Face Down Lying Shoulder Press is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Dumbbell Front Raise (Front View)
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell vertical with both hands, arms fully extended down.
Raise the dumbbell in front of you to shoulder height, keeping your arms straight.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement, ensuring your shoulders are not shrugging up towards your ears.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position in a controlled manner. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid swinging the weights; use a controlled motion to lift and lower the dumbbell.
Maintain a slight bend in your elbows to reduce joint strain.
Keep your shoulders down and relaxed throughout the exercise.
results.description: Dumbbell Front Raise (Front View) is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Dumbbell Front Raise
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms fully extended by your sides and palms facing your thighs.
Raise the dumbbells in front of you to shoulder height, keeping your arms straight and palms facing down.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement, ensuring your shoulders are not shrugging up towards your ears.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position in a controlled manner. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid swinging the weights; use a controlled motion to lift and lower the dumbbells.
Maintain a slight bend in your elbows to reduce joint strain.
Keep your shoulders down and relaxed throughout the exercise.
results.description: Dumbbell Front Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Military Press
instructions: Begin in a half-kneeling position with your right knee on the floor and left foot flat on the floor in front of you. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
Engage your core and press both dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to shoulder level with control, maintaining a steady motion.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your gaze forward and your neck in a neutral position.
Exhale as you press the dumbbells up and inhale as you lower them.
Ensure your front knee remains aligned over your ankle to maintain balance.
results.description: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Military Press is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Incline Breeding
instructions: Sit on an incline bench set at a 45-degree angle, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms extended, elbows slightly bent, above your chest and palms facing forward.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your sides in a wide arc, maintaining the slight bend in your elbows.
Bring the dumbbells back up in a controlled manner, following the same wide arc, until they meet above your chest.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, ensuring a controlled and steady motion throughout.
tips: Avoid locking your elbows; maintain a slight bend to protect your joints.
Ensure your wrists remain straight and aligned with your forearms.
Focus on a slow and controlled motion to maximize muscle engagement.
results.description: Dumbbell Incline Breeding is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Dumbbell Incline Front Raise
instructions: Lie on an incline bench set at a 45-degree angle with a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight, and palms facing down just over your thighs.
Raise both dumbbells in front of you, keeping your arms straight, until they reach opposite your chest.
Hold the position for a second, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining a steady and controlled motion.
tips: Avoid using momentum; focus on using your shoulder muscles to lift the weights.
Engage your core to stabilize your body and prevent arching of the back.
Exhale as you lift the dumbbells and inhale as you lower them.
results.description: Dumbbell Incline Front Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Chest.

results.name: Dumbbell Incline Hammer Shoulder Press
instructions: Lie on an incline bench set at a 45-degree angle with your feet flat on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with your palms facing each other (hammer grip) and elbows bent and set perpendicular to your torso.
Press the dumbbells forward in a controlled motion until your arms are fully extended opposite your chest, maintaining the hammer grip.
Return the dumbbells back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your wrists remain straight and aligned with your forearms.
Choose a weight that allows for proper form and control.
Focus on using your shoulder muscles to lift the weights, minimizing involvement from your chest.
results.description: Dumbbell Incline Hammer Shoulder Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Chest, Triceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Incline Lying Front Raise
instructions: Lie chest-first on an incline bench set at a 45-degree angle with your forefeet firm on the floor, allowing your arms to hang straight down with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing back.
Raise both dumbbells forward and upward until your arms are in level with your torso, maintaining a slight bend in your elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder muscles at the top of the movement, ensuring your arms are fully extended.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control, allowing your arms to hang down. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you raise the dumbbells and inhale as you lower them.
Avoid swinging the dumbbells; use a slow and controlled motion.
Maintain a slight bend in your elbows throughout the movement.
results.description: Dumbbell Incline Lying Front Raise is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.
